caseName: Humble Oil & Refining Co. v. Campbell
caseNameFull: Humble Oil & Refining Co. v. Campbell, Receiver
attorneys: Messrs. Edgar E. Townes and Robert M. Rowland for petitioner. Mr. H. C. Ray for respondents.

opinions.text: The petition for writ of certiorari herein is denied for failure to comply with Rule 381, paragraph 2, of the rules of this Court. The brief for.the petitioner is 211 pages and that of the respondent is 239 pages, in length. Both briefs are stricken from the files of this Court.
